title: Equil: TBR consistent fail, possible connection issue.
symptom: Temp Basal Rate fails to be set, with the pump falling back to default basal rates. The issue can persist even by retrying from the Loop plugin. Same bug presents itself even on earlier objectives when having to confirm the suggested temp basal rates manually. Frequency of this happening is often more than 50% of the times. Even cancelling TBR might fail. Bolusing also gave errors.
fix: A fix has been submitted in pull request #3376, which can be tried.
evidence_quote: I have submitted a fix, you can try it https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/3376
